C0279.title: Web Scraping Overreach Cannot Escape Legal Boundaries: Supreme People's Court Clarifies Criminal Prosecution for Illegal Data Scraping
C0279.summary: In March 2025, the Supreme People's Court emphasized that while web scraping technology serves as a cornerstone for search engines, its illegal use—even when generating massive traffic and profits—cannot evade legal consequences.
